population: all grid points across the 32 anchors in one clip
confidence: depth_conf_grid strictly above the per-clip 50th percentile of finite confidence values
gt_diagnostic: median(gt_depth / g3t_depth) on the identical selected grid points with finite positive GT depth and valid GT pose
grid: linspace(0,1000,51) over native canvas; GT pixel = clip(floor(uv/1000 * raster_size))
scale_bar: fraction with 0.8 <= estimated_scale / gt_scale <= 1.2 must be >= 0.75
depth_adoption: per scene G3T x s AbsRel <= 0.9 * V-C AbsRel on identical finite prediction pixels with valid GT pose and 0.1 < GT < 10
